location.ref: The Crown of Life, surat-śabd yoga as the crown

paraphrase: Haṭha, rāja, jñāna, bhakti and the other yogas lead only partway and are difficult for this age; the yoga of the sound current is natural, open to all, and takes the soul to the highest region.
speaker: Kirpal Singh
translation_basis: paraphrase from memory of the vernacular text (Phase B skeleton); to be checked against an edition in Phase D
notes: Skeleton from memory (Phase B). Sant Mat teaching (recent); locator at book/part level only.
